# TheRundown API

- [Real-Time Odds, Scores and Live Game State in One Sports Data API](https://docs.therundown.io/introduction.md): Integrate TheRundown sports data and odds API with REST, WebSocket on Ultra+, code samples, market IDs, usage limits, and sport-by-sport coverage.
- [Get Your Free API Key and Make Your First Call](https://docs.therundown.io/quickstart.md): Make your first authenticated sports odds API request, read usage headers, and choose REST or Ultra+ WebSocket. Free uses delayed pre-match data.
- [Authenticate and Start Calling the API in Minutes](https://docs.therundown.io/authentication.md): Learn how to authenticate your requests to TheRundown API using API keys.
- [Docs MCP: Let Your AI Agent Build the Integration](https://docs.therundown.io/documentation-mcp.md): Connect TheRundown API docs to Codex, Claude, Cursor, and other AI assistants.
- [Data MCP: Live Odds and Scores for AI Agents](https://docs.therundown.io/data-mcp.md): Connect an AI client to TheRundown hosted data MCP or the six-tool local starter. Compare versions, authentication, plan access and metered data reads.
- [AI discovery evaluation](https://docs.therundown.io/ai-evaluation.md): A public prompt corpus for evaluating how AI systems discover and describe TheRundown from official sources.
- [Data MCP design](https://docs.therundown.io/data-mcp-design.md): Architecture, data contracts, limits, and release criteria for the local TheRundown data MCP scaffold.
- [Rate Limits by Plan](https://docs.therundown.io/rate-limits.md): Understand data-point costs, plan history windows, per-second throttles, usage headers, and error responses.
- [Licensing & Attribution](https://docs.therundown.io/licensing-and-attribution.md): What your plan lets you do with TheRundown data, how to attribute it, and when you need a Supplemental Agreement.
- [Errors](https://docs.therundown.io/errors.md): HTTP status codes, error response formats, and troubleshooting guidance for TheRundown API.
- [FAQ: Coverage, Freshness, Plans and Pricing](https://docs.therundown.io/faq.md): Frequently asked questions about TheRundown API — data model, common issues, and integration tips.
- [Changelog](https://docs.therundown.io/changelog.md): Dated changes to TheRundown sports data API: new sports and sportsbooks, response fields, delivery and plan limits, newest first.
- [One Schema With Stable Event, Player and Team IDs](https://docs.therundown.io/reference/data-model.md): How events, markets, participants, lines, and prices relate to each other in the V2 API.
- [Coverage: 25+ Books](https://docs.therundown.io/reference/sports.md): Find sport IDs and coverage notes for TheRundown API. Query the sports catalog before selecting a league or assuming events are available.
- [Odds API Coverage by Sportsbook and League](https://docs.therundown.io/reference/coverage-matrix.md): Compare confirmed league coverage across sportsbooks and prediction markets in TheRundown sports data API.
- [Sportsbook / Affiliate IDs](https://docs.therundown.io/reference/sportsbooks.md): Look up sportsbook and affiliate IDs in TheRundown API and use the affiliate_ids filter to request prices from specific sources.
- [Market IDs](https://docs.therundown.io/reference/markets.md): Look up market IDs for prematch and live odds, including moneyline, spreads, totals and props. Check sport-specific market availability.
- [Period IDs](https://docs.therundown.io/reference/periods.md): Look up period IDs for full games, halves and quarters in TheRundown API. Distinguish prematch and live periods when filtering odds.
- [Live Game State](https://docs.therundown.io/reference/live-game-state.md): Period, clock, and sport-specific in-game situation, plus the play-by-play timeline shape.
- [Latency & Freshness](https://docs.therundown.io/reference/latency-and-freshness.md): How quickly odds and live game data reach you: sub-second odds, and measured p50/p95 WebSocket delivery times for live plays, scores, and box-score stats.
- [Event Status Codes](https://docs.therundown.io/reference/event-statuses.md): Understand event status codes in TheRundown sports data API and use them to display or process scheduled, live and finished events.
- [Sentinel Values](https://docs.therundown.io/reference/sentinel-values.md): Handle special odds and line values in TheRundown API, including off-the-board prices. Learn what sentinel values mean for an integration.
- [V2: List all sports](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-sports/list-all-sports.md): List every sport with its sport ID in the V2 odds API. No API key is required, so use it to map sport IDs before other requests.
- [Get available dates for multiple sports](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-sports/get-available-dates-for-multiple-sports.md): Get the dates with scheduled events for one or more sport IDs in one V2 odds API call, keyed by sport ID, to fill a date picker before requesting events.
- [Get events across sports for a date](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-sports/get-events-across-sports-for-a-date.md): Check which sports have scheduled events on a date. Returns the date keyed by sport ID, not event objects; request events per sport next.
- [Get available markets by date](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-sports/get-available-markets-by-date.md): Discover available market definitions for several sports on one date in a single V2 call, with the same filters as the single-sport markets route.
- [V2: Get teams for a sport](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-sports/get-teams-for-a-sport.md): Retrieve teams for a sport with the V2 sports data API. Review the sport ID parameter and documented response.
- [V2: Get available dates for a sport](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-sports/get-available-dates-for-a-sport.md): Find dates with data for a sport. Review the UTC offset before choosing a date; a date entry does not establish book or market availability.
- [V2: Get divisions for a sport](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-sports/get-divisions-for-a-sport.md): Retrieve divisions for a sport with the V2 sports data API. Review the sport ID parameter and documented response.
- [V2: Get conferences for a sport](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-sports/get-conferences-for-a-sport.md): Retrieve conferences for a sport with the V2 sports data API. Review the sport ID parameter and documented response.
- [V2: Get events by sport and date](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-events/get-events-with-markets-for-a-sport-and-date.md): Retrieve events and markets for one sport and date. Review UTC offsets, market and book filters, scores-only requests and closed-price options.
- [V2: Get opening lines for a sport and date](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-events/get-opening-lines-for-a-sport-and-date.md): Retrieve the earliest recorded line price per sportsbook for a sport and date. Prices can be recorded before, during or after an event.
- [V2: Get closing lines for a sport and date](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-events/get-closing-lines-for-a-sport-and-date.md): Retrieve each available line's latest price at or before scheduled event start. Review provisional snapshots, closed prices and plan-based history limits.
- [V2: Get an event with markets](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-events/get-a-single-event-with-markets.md): Retrieve one event's markets, participants, lines and book prices. Scope by market, participant or sportsbook and review closed-line filtering.
- [Get opening prices for an event](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-events/get-opening-prices-for-an-event.md): Read the earliest recorded line prices per sportsbook for one event. Review the events-array response and when opening snapshots are available.
- [Get closing prices for an event](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-events/get-closing-prices-for-an-event.md): Read closing prices for one event in the events array. Review the scheduled-start cutoff, provisional snapshots and plan-based historical-data limits.
- [Get best available line for an event](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-events/get-best-available-line-for-an-event.md): Get the best moneyline, spread and total for one event across sportsbooks, with the book behind each side's price. Any period, including live.
- [Get play-by-play for an event](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-events/get-play-by-play-for-an-event.md): Read an event's play-by-play timeline, periods, game clock and running score. Live game state and play-by-play require Ultra or higher.
- [Get event changes since a delta ID](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-events/get-event-changes-since-a-delta-id.md): Poll V2 event changes using a delta cursor. Read the serialized JSON payloads and use meta.delta_last_id for the next request.
- [Get available markets for a sport and date](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-markets/get-available-markets-for-a-sport-and-date.md): Discover available market definitions for one sport and date. Check the date offset and supported filters before fetching event prices from the API.
- [Get available markets for an event](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-markets/get-available-markets-for-an-event.md): List the market definitions available for one event, without prices. Use the returned market IDs with the event endpoint to fetch prices.
- [Get market price history for an event](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-markets/get-market-price-history-for-an-event.md): Read recorded price changes for one event. Pass one to three distinct sportsbook IDs; availability and lookback depend on the API plan.
- [Get opening prices for an event's markets](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-markets/get-opening-prices-for-an-events-markets.md): Retrieve opening market prices for an event with the V2 odds API. Review the event ID parameter and documented response.
- [Get line price chart data for a specific market](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-markets/get-line-price-chart-data-for-a-specific-market.md): Chart market line prices over time by sportsbook. Discover the public participant_id first to separate sides such as Over and Under.
- [List all market definitions](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-markets/list-all-market-definitions.md): Browse the V2 market catalog by market ID, with classification, sport membership and in-play flags. Filters are optional and combine with AND.
- [Get market price changes since a given ID](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-markets/get-market-price-changes-since-a-given-id.md): Poll market price changes with a valid zero-delay snapshot cursor. Review cursor recovery, live market IDs and plan-delay requirements.
- [Get price history for market line prices](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-markets/get-price-history-for-specific-market-line-prices.md): Retrieve price history for specific market line prices with the V2 odds API. Review query parameters and response fields.
- [Get market participants](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-markets/get-market-participants.md): Find team, player or result participant IDs for an event's markets. Use the returned participant_id to request participant-specific price history.
- [Get futures for a sport](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-futures/get-futures-for-a-sport.md): List futures competitions with odds and settlement state. Review interval-overlap date filters and cursor pagination. Requires Ultra or higher.
- [V2 futures competition details](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-futures/get-one-futures-competition.md): Read one futures competition with odds, settlement state and optional progress or leaderboards. Requires Ultra or higher; fields vary by competition.
- [Get a team by ID](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-teams/get-a-team-by-id.md): Retrieve a team by team ID with the V2 sports data API. Review the request parameter and documented response.
- [Get players for a team](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-teams/get-players-for-a-team.md): Retrieve players for a team with the V2 sports data API. Review the team ID parameter and documented response.
- [Get season stats for a team](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-teams/get-season-stats-for-a-team.md): Retrieve season stats for a team with the V2 sports data API. Review the team ID parameter and documented response.
- [Get player season stats for a team](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-teams/get-player-season-stats-for-a-team.md): Retrieve player season stats for a team with the V2 sports data API. Review the team ID parameter and documented response.
- [Get a player by ID](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-players/get-a-player-by-id.md): Retrieve a player by player ID with the V2 sports data API. Review the request parameter and documented response.
- [Stats](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/v2/stats.md): Stat definitions, REST box scores, and live team/player game-stat deltas
- [Get a fixed complete-game stats sample](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-stats/get-fixed-complete-game-stats-sample.md): Get a fixed game-stats sample for schema tests with an API key and zero data points. This is sample data, not a production feed; do not poll it.
- [Get team game stats for an event](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-stats/get-team-game-stats-for-an-event.md): Retrieve team game stats for an event with the V2 sports data API. Review request parameters and response fields.
- [Get player game stats for an event](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-stats/get-player-game-stats-for-an-event.md): Retrieve player game stats for an event with the V2 sports data API. Review request parameters and response fields.
- [List all stat definitions](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-stats/list-all-stat-definitions.md): List stat definitions with the V2 sports data API. Review request parameters and the documented response.
- [V2: List all sportsbooks/affiliates](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-reference/list-all-sportsbooksaffiliates.md): Find published sportsbook and affiliate IDs with integration status. Use current IDs to filter odds; availability varies by sport and market.
- [List all sportsbooks (alias for /affiliates)](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-reference/list-all-sportsbooks-alias-for-affiliates.md): List sportsbook reference data through the V2 sportsbooks alias for affiliates. Review the documented request and response.
- [V2: List season types per sport](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-reference/list-season-types-per-sport.md): List season types by sport with the V2 sports data API. Review request parameters and the documented response.
- [WebSocket](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/v2/websocket.md): Real-time streaming of odds, scores, plays, and game stats via WebSocket
- [Connection limits](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/v2/websocket-connection-limits.md): How many WebSocket connections a plan can hold, and when a 429 releases.
- [V2 WebSocket: market prices](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-websocket/markets-websocket-—-stream-real-time-market-price-updates.md): Stream V2 market price updates from a server-side WebSocket client. Review authentication, filters and heartbeats. Requires Ultra or higher.
- [V2 WebSocket: multiplexed channels](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v2-websocket/multiplexed-websocket-—-subscribe-to-markets-scores-plays-and-live-channels.md): Subscribe to market, score, play, stat and live channels on one V2 WebSocket. Review server-side authentication and entitlements; Ultra or higher.
- [Get a single event with lines](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v1-events/get-a-single-event-with-lines.md): Retrieve one event and its lines by event ID with the V1 sports data API. Review request parameters and response fields.
- [Get event by line ID](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v1-events/get-event-by-line-id.md): Look up an event and a specific line by event ID and line ID with the V1 sports data API. Review the request and response.
- [Get events with lines for a sport and date](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v1-events/get-events-with-lines-for-a-sport-and-date.md): Retrieve events and lines for a sport and date through the V1 sports data API. Review request parameters and response fields.
- [V1: Get opening lines for a sport and date](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v1-events/get-opening-lines-for-a-sport-and-date.md): Retrieve opening lines for a sport and date through the V1 odds API. Review request parameters and response fields.
- [V1: Get closing lines for a sport and date](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v1-events/get-closing-lines-for-a-sport-and-date.md): Retrieve closing lines for a sport and date through the V1 odds API. Review request parameters and response fields.
- [Get best lines for multiple events](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v1-lines/get-best-lines-for-multiple-events.md): Retrieve best lines for multiple events with the V1 odds API. Review the request parameters and documented response.
- [Get moneyline price history for a line](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v1-lines/get-moneylines-for-an-event.md): Read historical moneyline prices for a line ID through the V1 odds API. Review the request parameters and response fields.
- [Get spread price history for a line](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v1-lines/get-spreads-for-an-event.md): Read historical spread prices for a line ID through the V1 odds API. Review the request parameters and response fields.
- [Get total (over/under) price history for a line](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v1-lines/get-totals-overunder-for-an-event.md): Read historical total prices for a line ID through the V1 odds API. Review the request parameters and response fields.
- [Get team totals for a line](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v1-lines/get-team-totals-for-an-event.md): Retrieve V1 team totals for a line ID. Current events return no rows; use V2 market 94 (Team Totals) for current team totals.
- [V1: List all sports](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v1-sports/list-all-sports.md): List the sports catalog with the V1 sports data API. Review request parameters and the documented response.
- [V1: Get teams for a sport](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v1-sports/get-teams-for-a-sport.md): Retrieve teams for a sport with the V1 sports data API. Review the sport ID parameter and documented response.
- [V1: Get divisions for a sport](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v1-sports/get-divisions-for-a-sport.md): Retrieve divisions for a sport with the V1 sports data API. Review the sport ID parameter and documented response.
- [V1: Get conferences for a sport](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v1-sports/get-conferences-for-a-sport.md): Retrieve conferences for a sport with the V1 sports data API. Review the sport ID parameter and documented response.
- [V1: Get available dates for a sport](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v1-sports/get-available-dates-for-a-sport.md): Find dates available for a sport with the V1 sports data API. Review the sport ID parameter and documented response.
- [Get event schedule for a sport](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v1-sports/get-event-schedule-for-a-sport.md): List scheduled events for one sport using the non-billable V1 schedule endpoint. Review date filters and usage-window response headers.
- [Get event deltas (V1 format)](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v1-delta/get-event-deltas-v1-format.md): Retrieve event updates with the V1 delta endpoint. Review query parameters and the documented V1 response format.
- [Get event deltas (V2 format via V1 path)](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v1-delta/get-event-deltas-v2-format-via-v1-path.md): Retrieve event updates in V2 format through the V1 deltaV2 path. Review request parameters and the documented response.
- [V1: List all sportsbooks/affiliates](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v1-reference/list-all-sportsbooksaffiliates.md): List sportsbook and affiliate reference data with the V1 sports data API. Review request parameters and response fields.
- [List all sportsbooks (alias)](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v1-reference/list-all-sportsbooks-alias.md): List sportsbook reference data through the V1 sportsbooks alias. Review request parameters and the documented response.
- [V1: List season types per sport](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v1-reference/list-season-types-per-sport.md): List season types by sport with the V1 sports data API. Review request parameters and the documented response.
- [V1 WebSocket: event and market updates](https://docs.therundown.io/api-reference/generated/v1-websocket/v1-websocket-—-stream-real-time-event-and-market-updates.md): Review the legacy V1 WebSocket for event and market updates, filters and heartbeat behavior. New integrations should use V2 streaming.
- [Get Real-Time Odds From Every Book in One Call](https://docs.therundown.io/guides/getting-live-odds.md): Fetch real-time moneylines, spreads, and totals from multiple sportsbooks using the V2 events endpoint.
- [Building an Odds Screen](https://docs.therundown.io/guides/building-odds-screen.md): Step-by-step guide to building a real-time odds screen with moneyline, spread, and total columns using TheRundown API and WebSocket.
- [Historical Odds & Line Movement](https://docs.therundown.io/guides/historical-odds.md): Retrieve opening lines, closing lines, and full price history to build line movement charts and analyze odds changes over time.
- [Event history sportsbook limit](https://docs.therundown.io/guides/historical-odds-affiliate-note.md): affiliate_ids is required on event market history, and accepts 1 to 3 sportsbook ids.
- [Scores and Results](https://docs.therundown.io/guides/scores-and-results.md): Check event completion before grading, read final and per-period scores, and retrieve results within your plan's history and data-point limits.
- [Player Props](https://docs.therundown.io/guides/player-props.md): Fetch player prop odds including points, rebounds, assists, three-pointers, and combo markets using the V2 markets system.
- [Stats Access](https://docs.therundown.io/guides/stats-access.md): Understand the new-account stats policy, legacy access, fixed samples, coverage limits, and upgrades.
- [Futures & Outrights](https://docs.therundown.io/guides/futures.md): List championship and tournament-winner boards, page through competitions, and keep futures prices fresh with the markets delta feed.
- [WebSocket Streaming](https://docs.therundown.io/guides/websocket-streaming.md): Connect to TheRundown WebSocket feeds for real-time odds, scores, plays, and game-stat updates.
- [Multiplexed WebSocket](https://docs.therundown.io/guides/multiplexed-websocket.md): Subscribe to markets, scores, play-by-play, live game stats, and live game state over a single connection to /api/v2/ws.
- [V1 to V2 Migration Guide](https://docs.therundown.io/guides/v1-to-v2-migration.md): Understand the differences between V1 and V2 data models and migrate your application from the legacy lines format to the new markets-based system.
- [Efficient Polling](https://docs.therundown.io/guides/efficient-polling.md): Optimize data-point usage with delta endpoints, tight filters, smart polling intervals, and caching strategies.
- [Python SDK](https://docs.therundown.io/sdks/python.md): Use TheRundown API from Python with the requests library and websockets for real-time data.
- [JavaScript SDK](https://docs.therundown.io/sdks/javascript.md): Use TheRundown API from Node.js with Fetch and ws for real-time streaming.
- [Go SDK](https://docs.therundown.io/sdks/go.md): Use TheRundown API from Go with net/http for REST calls and gorilla/websocket for real-time streaming.
